title: HEO to use Planet satellites for non-Earth imaging
summary: HEO, an Australian company specializing in non-Earth imaging of spacecraft, has partnered with Planet to utilize its satellite data. This collaboration aims to enhance HEO's capabilities in monitoring and analyzing objects in space.

title: New EU sanctions target leaders of Russia’s space industry
summary: The European Union has imposed sanctions targeting the head of a Roscosmos subsidiary involved in developing a synthetic aperture radar satellite system for the Russian military. This action is part of broader EU measures against Russia's space industry.

title: ULA names Peller as new CEO
summary: United Launch Alliance (ULA) has appointed Mark Peller, a long-serving executive, as its new CEO. The announcement marks a leadership transition within the company.

title: L3Harris names space sector leader Sam Mehta CEO after Kubasik steps down
summary: L3Harris has appointed Sam Mehta as CEO of its space sector following the departure of Christopher Kubasik due to an unspecified conduct investigation. The leadership change aims to drive growth in the company's space division.

title: The 77th International Astronautical Congress (IAC 2026) is the One Space Event You Cannot Miss
summary: The 77th International Astronautical Congress (IAC 2026) is highlighted as a must-attend event for the global space community, marking over 75 years of annual gatherings.

title: SEOPS adds second Waymaker rideshare mission
summary: SEOPS has announced a second Waymaker rideshare mission due to high demand, following the success of its first mission announced less than three months prior.

title: A rocket crashed into the moon. It was harmless, but the next one might not be.
summary: A SpaceX Falcon 9 upper stage crashed into the moon at high speed, raising concerns about future uncontrolled lunar impacts. The incident was harmless but highlights potential risks from increasing space debris.

title: Long March 12 launches despite recent 7A failure, Long March 2C launches satellite for UAE
summary: China launched a new batch of Guowang megaconstellation satellites and a developmental satellite for the UAE using Long March 12 and Long March 2C rockets, respectively. This occurred despite a recent failure of the Long March 7A rocket.

title: Lynk and Omnispace form Elveo Mobile to advance D2D services
summary: Lynk Global and Omnispace merged to form Elveo Mobile, rebranding to advance direct-to-device satellite services with expanded S-band spectrum capabilities. The new entity aims to enhance global connectivity beyond basic messaging.

title: Satellite operators emphasize launch deals in a constrained market
summary: Satellite operators are assuring investors and customers about secured launch capacity despite uncertainties in availability due to a constrained launch market.

title: How an ancient collision with another galaxy transformed the Milky Way
summary: A recent study reveals that an ancient collision with another galaxy significantly transformed the Milky Way, uncovering previously unknown merger history. This discovery sheds light on the galaxy's evolution over billions of years.

title: China bounces back from Long March rocket explosion with back-to-back launches (video)
summary: China resumed space launches after a Long March 7A rocket explosion, successfully deploying a Long March 12 and a Long March 2C rocket in back-to-back missions.

title: The best Ruko drone to date is half-price at Amazon but you'll have to hurry
summary: The Ruko F11 PRO 2 drone is currently available at a 50% discount on Amazon, priced at $280. This limited-time offer is a beginner-friendly option for those interested in drone flying.

title: Scientists find dead star that predicts our sun's future: 'Broken apart and returned to the galaxy'
summary: Scientists discovered a dead star that offers insights into the future of our sun, showing how it may eventually break apart and return material to the galaxy. The findings were revealed through a composite image from the Hubble Space Telescope and other observatories, highlighting the Helix Nebula.

title: The 1st 'Star Wars: Ahsoka' season 2 trailer finally gives us a release date (video)
summary: The first trailer for 'Star Wars: Ahsoka' season 2 has been released, revealing the upcoming season's release date and showcasing epic space battles, Clone Wars flashbacks, and appearances by Anakin Skywalker.

title: Scientists find 3 supermassive black holes on the verge of collision inside a distant galaxy
summary: Scientists discovered three supermassive black holes on the verge of collision in a distant galaxy that existed less than 1.3 billion years after the Big Bang. This rare find suggests the galaxy was actively hoarding these massive objects during the early universe.

title: On this day in space! Aug. 17, 1877: Asaph Hall Discovers the Martian moon Phobos
summary: American astronomer Asaph Hall discovered Mars's moon Phobos on August 17, 1877. This marked a significant milestone in the early exploration of the Martian system.

title: These eight Lego Star Wars Smart Play sets are out now and Marvel needs to be next.
summary: Lego has released eight new Star Wars-themed Smart Play sets. The article suggests Marvel-themed sets could be next.

summary: A trillion-mile-long cosmic gas stream is disrupting a young planet-forming system in the Orion constellation, causing planets to tilt in their orbits.

title: Launch Preview: Chang’e 7 headlines week of Chinese and Starlink launches
summary: China is preparing for the Chang'e 7 lunar mission following a recent launch failure. The mission is expected to headline a week of launches alongside Starlink missions.

summary: Blue Origin is planning dual launch pad operations at Cape Canaveral by restoring its primary pad at LC-36A. The company has outlined its vision for expanded launch capabilities.

summary: Rocket Lab has established a new subsidiary in Germany and introduced a containerized mobile launch system. These announcements highlight the company's expansion and innovation in space launch capabilities.

summary: China's Wenchang Space Launch Site celebrated its 50th launch milestone while also experiencing a failure. The site launched AI satellites and is preparing for a lunar south pole mission.

title: Starbase Production lining up future vehicles
summary: SpaceX is progressing multiple Starship vehicles at its Starbase production site. Teams are lining up future vehicles for upcoming missions.

summary: The week of Aug. 10 featured four international launches across three countries, following a Chinese launch failure. The event highlights a busy period in global spaceflight activity.

summary: NASA has provided updates on the Artemis program, detailing progress in building a roadmap for returning humans to the Moon. The updates include plans for commercial robotic lunar missions.

summary: Relativity Space has achieved a key milestone in integrating engines for its reusable Terran-R rocket's first stage. This marks progress in the development of the company's next-generation launch vehicle.

title: TEC Business to Business website
summary: The news source is a B2B website focused on the technology, electronics, and computing sectors, including space industry coverage.

summary: ESA celebrates 50 years with a booklet highlighting 50 major achievements. The publication marks five decades of the European Space Agency's contributions to space exploration and technology.

summary: Proba-3 mission will create an artificial solar eclipse hours before the total solar eclipse in Europe. The mission aims to study the Sun's corona by blocking the solar disk.

title: A double eclipse for Proba-3
summary: The Proba-3 mission will observe a double eclipse, capturing the Moon crossing its field of view. This event highlights the mission's precision in studying solar corona and space weather.

title: How ESA mimics and models the 2026 total solar eclipse
summary: ESA is preparing to study the 2026 total solar eclipse by using artificial eclipse missions and computer simulations to observe the Sun's corona. This approach allows scientists to gather more data than a natural eclipse would permit.

title: Your chance to run software in deep space on ESA's asteroid mission
summary: The European Space Agency (ESA) is inviting European researchers and companies to run their software aboard the Hera mission, which will travel millions of kilometers into deep space. This is a unique opportunity to test innovative software in a real deep-space environment.

title: From drone flight to sounding rocket
summary: A student-developed radar retroreflector technology was tested for the first time using a drone at ESTEC, the European Space Agency's technical center in the Netherlands.

summary: ESA's Proba-3 mission will demonstrate formation flying by having a coronagraph block the Sun to observe the solar corona, effectively playing 'hide and seek' with Earth's view. The mission aims to study the Sun's outer atmosphere with unprecedented precision.

title: Meet space startups at ESA’s Industry Space Days
summary: ESA's Industry Space Days event will showcase innovative space startups and foster collaboration with European space industry on September 16-17. The event aims to exchange ideas and explore opportunities at ESA-ESTEC in the Netherlands.

title: The silicon brains steering next-generation antennas
summary: The article discusses advancements in silicon-based technology for next-generation antennas. These innovations are expected to enhance communication and radar systems in the space industry.

title: DIU, SDA Select Winners for Deorbit-as-a-Service Designs
summary: The Space Development Agency (SDA) and Defense Innovation Unit (DIU) selected three companies to design scalable satellite capabilities for rendezvous, capture, and deorbit. This initiative aims to address space debris mitigation through a 'Deorbit-as-a-Service' model.

title: SEOPS Doubles Down on Waymaker Dedicated Rideshare Program
summary: SEOPS is expanding its Waymaker Dedicated Rideshare Program to fill the gap left by SpaceX's Transporter program, offering cost-effective rides to orbit for space startups.

summary: The commercial space industry is shifting towards customers building their own spacecraft hardware for full mission ownership, moving beyond just affordability and accessibility. This trend represents a new middle ground in spacecraft development.

summary: Reflect Orbital faces criticism over its sunlight-reflecting satellites, with the space community divided on the idea. The company has responded to these concerns.

title: Rocket Lab Enters Europe’s Crowded Launch Market

summary: Conflicts worldwide have increased the demand for space-based intelligence among governments and militaries. BlackSky's CTO discusses the growing adoption and cost-efficiency of satellite-based solutions.

summary: The U.S. Space Force awarded contracts to five satellite manufacturers to develop a more diverse multi-vendor architecture for its space data network. This move aims to enhance the resilience and capabilities of the Space Force's satellite infrastructure.

summary: Astranis announced the unveiling of its new 'Perceptor' satellite designed for space domain awareness and maneuverability in GEO orbit. This marks Astranis' latest expansion into the space domain awareness market.

title: CesiumAstro Acquires Semiconductor Company Jariet Technologies
summary: CesiumAstro has acquired semiconductor company Jariet Technologies to enhance its communications and sensing systems for commercial, civil, and national security customers.

title: Planet Labs to Support Government, Public Services in Rwanda
summary: Rwanda is collaborating with Planet Labs to launch a national program leveraging satellite technology for government and public services. Planet Labs will provide support to enhance these efforts.

title: Mantis Space Appoints Ex-Boeing Exec as CTO
summary: Mantis Space has appointed Dale Parkes, a former Boeing executive, as its new Chief Technology Officer. The appointment coincides with the company's efforts to develop a constellation of spacecraft for continuous Earth orbit operations.

title: Impulse Space Wins New Space Force Contract
